rationale: The first 5 minutes after the 09:30 open set a range, and the first 5-minute close outside it shows acceptance, so trading with that close carries the morning. Losing side: traders who fade the first close outside the opening range, and stops resting just beyond it
notes: N3 orb_confirm: range = the first or_min minutes from 09:30; a bar closes above it -> market long (dir long) / below it -> market short (dir short); LONG-ONLY and SHORT-ONLY are separate MIRROR units; one trade per session instance.
